svg.title: What the agent-controls announcement establishes
svg.desc: Three bands. Established across outlets: no standing access, a continuously updated per-agent risk score, graduated conditional access, and local discovery of sixty agent types. Single-source or conflicting: the Microsoft 365 E7 bundle at ninety-nine dollars per user per month, and whether the prior discovery figure was twenty-five or thirty-five. Unestablished: how the score is weighted, where the band thresholds sit, and whether a past score can be replayed.
svg.text: Sort the announcement by how well each claim is established.
